speaker: host
text: Our last video about McDonald's blew up, and the comments are fighting over Ray Kroc. But almost nobody knows where their money actually comes from.

speaker: guest
text: Because McDonald's isn't a burger chain. They're a thirty billion dollar real estate empire.

speaker: guest
text: The burgers are just the bait. Ray Kroc's genius was buying the physical land under every restaurant. If a franchisee wants to sell fries, they have to pay McDonald's rent first.

speaker: host
text: So they make more from rent than burgers?

speaker: guest
text: Eighty percent of their profit is pure rent and franchise royalties. McDonald's is a real estate monopoly in disguise.

speaker: host
text: Which is why our last video was only the beginning.
